title: Fannie Mae Desktop Underwriter: minimum credit score requirement for loan casefiles
issuer_of_rule: Fannie Mae, Selling Guide Announcement SEL-2025-09 (2025-11-05) and Desktop Underwriter Version 12.0 release notes (2025-09-24)
supersedes: a minimum representative credit score of 620 (one borrower) and a minimum average median credit score of 620 (more than one borrower) for DU loan casefiles, in force for casefiles created through 2025-11-15

cells.applies_to: DU loan casefiles created on or after the effective date
cells.replaced_by: a minimum credit risk standard based on DU's evaluation of credit risk factors (Selling Guide B3-2-03)

cells.applies_to: DU loan casefiles created before the effective date
cells.basis: representative score for one borrower; average median score for more than one borrower

also_in_the_same_update: the minimum representative credit score of 720 for borrowers financing a second home or investment property with multiple financed properties was removed for casefiles submitted or resubmitted on or after the weekend of 2025-11-15

required_qualifiers: loan casefile created on or after 2025-11-16
lenders and mortgage insurers may set their own minimum scores
does_not_establish: the requirement for manually underwritten loans (the announcement does not address them)
that any lender will approve a loan with a score below 620
how credit scores are used in pricing, mortgage insurance or delivery
anything about one applicant's chance of approval
